name: Zafra

tokens.name: zafra-red
tokens.usage: Zafra Red, the hero colour. CMYK 0 85 100 0, RGB 245 71 28, Pantone 3556 U / 3556 C. Primary brand colour: sign-offs, title slides, branded headers; solid field with the cream logo. On soft-cream it reaches 3.4:1, so use it for display text 24px and up, never for body copy.

tokens.name: zafra-deep-red
tokens.usage: Zafra Deep Red. CMYK 25 100 90 0, RGB 180 0 41, Pantone 207 U / 207 C. Default text colour on soft-cream (6.6:1) and on petal-mist (6.4:1); also a deep ground for soft-cream text.

tokens.name: royal-saffron-violet
tokens.usage: Royal Saffron Violet. CMYK 0 85 15 42, RGB 148 22 126, Pantone 2602 U / 2602 C. Secondary text and headline colour (7.4:1 on soft-cream); deep ground for soft-cream, leaf-accent or saffron-glow text.

tokens.name: magenta-bloom
tokens.usage: Magenta Bloom. CMYK 0 65 15 15, RGB 212 74 182, Pantone Purple U / Purple C (alt 2395 C). Accent fields and illustration. 3.6:1 on soft-cream: large text only.

tokens.name: saffron-glow
tokens.usage: Saffron Glow. CMYK 0 24 77 0, RGB 255 193 60, Pantone 123 U / 123 C. Sun-warmed fields and the Zero Sugar hero background (brand book). Red logo allowed on it. Pair with royal-saffron-violet text (4.8:1); never zafra-red on it (2.2:1).

tokens.name: soft-cream
tokens.usage: Soft Cream. CMYK 0 2 15 0, RGB 255 249 218, Pantone 7499 U / C (approx). The brand's paper: default page background and the logo colour on red.

tokens.name: petal-mist
tokens.usage: Petal Mist. CMYK 0 6 0 0, RGB 255 240 255, Pantone 706 U / C (approx). Soft alternate background for cards and sections; text in zafra-deep-red or royal-saffron-violet.

tokens.name: leaf-accent
tokens.usage: Leaf Accent. CMYK 18 0 54 0, RGB 210 255 117, Pantone 387 U / C (approx). Small pops only (tags, stickers, highlights). Text on it in royal-saffron-violet (6.8:1).

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Pure white. Only for the white logo version and where a platform forces white; soft-cream is the brand's light colour.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Default page background.

tokens.name: surface-alt
tokens.usage: Alternate section or card background.

tokens.name: surface-brand
tokens.usage: Bold brand band; put on-brand text on it.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body and UI text on surface and surface-alt.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, subheads on surface.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and logo on surface-brand (3.4:1: 24px and larger, or bold 19px and larger).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Primary buttons, links in large sizes, focus rings on surface.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Hero lines. Euclid Flex, ALL CAPS (brand book). Falls back to Rubik until licensed.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Page titles. Euclid Flex, ALL CAPS (brand book). Falls back to Rubik until licensed.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Section titles. Euclid Flex, ALL CAPS (brand book). Falls back to Rubik until licensed.

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Card and sub-section titles. Brand book allows one headline size per layout: use h3 only when h1/h2 are not on the page.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Eyebrows, tags, buttons. Euclid Flex per brand book; ALL CAPS.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon and text gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight stacks, tag padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Card padding, paragraph gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gaps between cards.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Section padding on mobile.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Section padding on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, small tags.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, image frames, colour blocks.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons and stickers; echoes the round, brushy script of the wordmark.

_source: Zafra Brand Guidelines v1.2 (Nov 2025) + palette sheet. Shapes and spacing are Bower defaults.
